record.name: YouTube Transcript
record.one_liner: YouTube Transcript API provides endpoints to extract transcripts, search videos, browse channels, and extract playlists via REST API or YouTube MCP.

auth.notes: Uses Bearer token authentication with an API key included in the Authorization header.

access.notes: Users can sign up for an account and get an API key from their dashboard.

api_surface.notes: Offers a REST API at https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2 and supports Model Context Protocol (MCP).

mcp.notes: Supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and custom agent workflows.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credentials can be obtained by signing up, and the REST API and MCP integration are thoroughly documented.
